notes.title: New Card Designs Unveiled
notes.notes:
Our team has been working hard on a significant update in Sigils of Nightfall: the introduction of new card types and disturbing visuals that deepen and enrich the gameplay experience. We reimagined each card, creating a darker, more immersive aesthetic that embodies the game’s themes.

[h3]New Card Types
[/h3]Prepare to discover new card types that unlock unique strategies, add fresh layers to deckbuilding, and create deeper interactions within battles. From devastating offensive abilities to relentless curses that bring ruin over time, every card holds the power to seal your fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/45820c3faee155214764417bced8e1be88e9e55b.png[/img]
[h3]Art & Visuals
[/h3]Each card has been given a stunning visual overhaul, with distinctive artwork that reflects the sinister beauty of Sigils of Nightfall’s universe. Our goal was to make each card a work of art, embodying the dark apocalyptic atmosphere and occult mystique that define the game.

[h3]Card Anatomy
[/h3]The card interface has also been refined to deliver a smoother, more intuitive experience. Each card type now has unique style cues, and the layout is clearer, making it easier to navigate your deck and execute strategic decisions in the heat of battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/61a403e3c2d1101b48a44147a659039c62936845.png[/img]
Unleash these new powers. The darkness awaits!

notes.title: The nightmarish creatures are now ALIVE!
notes.notes:
[b]Betu Souza[/b] is a Brazilian artist and animator with a distinctive style, often blending traditional and digital techniques to create visually striking artwork. Betu Souza has contributed to various projects, both in Brazil and internationally, and his work is appreciated for its attention to detail and the ability to convey strong narratives through imagery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/10f748d9b3b918fecfa9d94cd59c7b48259ad1dc.png[/img]

Betu played a key role in shaping the visual identity of their games. Well-known for titles like C[i]hroma Squad[/i], a tactical RPG inspired by Power Rangers, [i]Knights of Pen & Paper[/i], a turn-based RPG that simulates a tabletop experience, as well as [i]Relic Hunters Zero[/i] and [i]Relic Hunters Legend[/i], Betu's work at ensured a cohesive and engaging visual style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/ced086844a82d5bd75e15d0d342b4394cf7b2fcb.gif[/img]

He is now channeling his extensive experience into animating [i]Sigils of Nightfall[/i]. His work on the game focuses on bringing its eerie, dark characters to life,  adding depth and fluidity to this haunting experience. Betu's unique style now makes each scene more immersive and visually striking, and his attention to detail and creative vision make his contributions an essential part of the game's atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/13573f6095f783ab07425c033f2c2fb11cad420c.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/e96bbe8f397c27c235bf199bde0614694a005407.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Artist behind Sigils of Nightfall: Meet Thiago Lehmann
notes.notes:
[b]Thiago Lehmann[/b]’s artistic style is characterized by his ability to fuse fantasy elements with meticulous detail, bringing to life characters that are both fantastical and believable. His work is heavily inspired by the realms of fantasy, horror, and science fiction, often featuring creatures and characters that are otherworldly yet grounded in reality.

His work on [i]Throne of Bones[/i] translates his mastery in creating dark, atmospheric character designs that evoke a sense of dread and intrigue. By exploring themes of death, decay, and the macabre, resulting in a collection of characters that are both haunting and visually compelling, this project highlights his skill in connecting the fantasy and horror genres. This showed us he was the right artist for Sigils of Nightfall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/1e87fd724a819382778b3cefea80b9ce7416ce66.png[/img]

Another of Thiago’s notable personal projects is [i]BugWorld[/i], a series of character designs inspired by insects. This project showcases his ability to take inspiration from nature and transform it into something both familiar and entirely new. Each character in BugWorld is a testament to his creativity, blending real nature with imaginative flair.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/4b0a39be6bfe8ee8b80d2a1293531ca75f35049a.png[/img]

In addition to his personal projects, Thiago has contributed to some of the most popular games in the industry. His work on [i]Dota 2 [/i]and [i]Path of Exile[/i] has been widely recognized, with his designs helping to shape the visual identity of these games. His contributions to these projects have cemented his reputation as a leading figure in game art and design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/86702b6af99e4f1d49edd6f383a692e366197f6a.png[/img]
Currently, Thiago Lehmann is bringing his talents to [b]Sigils of Nightfall[/b], where he is contributing to the game's dark and immersive world. His expertise in character design enhances the game's atmosphere, adding depth and detail to the characters that players will encounter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/521d5e4bb48fd6c57bce28d8d802e20e126c5af7.png[/img]

notes.title: The first Sigil has broken: Introducing Sigils of Nightfall
notes.notes:
Greetings, lost souls! We’re thrilled to unveil [b]Sigils of Nightfall[/b], our upcoming roguelike deckbuilder and first digital game that plunges you into the apocalyptic world of [i]Mörk Borg[/i]. Set within the cursed depths of Mountain’s Penance, a fortress-turned-prison, this game challenges you to survive against overwhelming odds in a place where death is not the end, but a doorway to something far darker.

[previewyoutube=EooIbzE_Hmk;full][/previewyoutube]
In Sigils of Nightfall, every decision you make could be your last. With a blend of fast-paced, tactical combat and dungeon-crawling, you’ll need to rely on your wits, your deck, and a bit of luck to navigate the treacherous halls, catacombs, and flesh-riddled tunnels of this decaying fortress. As you encounter twisted cultists, restless undead, and nightmarish creatures, you’ll uncover the secrets of the sigils that hold the world together—or hasten its destruction.

Prepare yourself for an experience where each run is different from the last. By choosing your path as you delve deep into the mountain and discovering a huge variety of cards and relics, Sigils of Nightfall offers endless replayability. Whether you’re an experienced deckbuilder or new to the genre, this game promises to test your strategic thinking and resource management in a setting drenched in gothic horror and despair.

Stay tuned for more updates, including deep dives into the game’s mechanics, lore, and the terrifying enemies you’ll face. Follow and add Sigils of Nightfall to your wishlist to be the first to know any news about the game. Welcome to the darkness.
